gitHeadMeaning: HEAD before publication; the checksummed worktree files may include uncommitted PR changes. Per-file Git blob identities tie these files to a later commit.

hashContract.raw: SHA256 over exact bytes read from the local worktree. CRLF/LF conversion changes this value, so raw hashes are platform-sensitive.
hashContract.lfNormalized: SHA256 after replacing CRLF with LF in UTF-8 text; all other characters remain unchanged.
hashContract.aggregate: Ordered lexical file paths with forward slashes: aggregatePath + NUL + content + NUL for each file. Raw and LF-normalized aggregates use the same ordering.
hashContract.gitBlobSha1: Read-only git hash-object --stdin-paths with the checkout clean filters, without -w. This is the Git blob identity expected when these files are staged under the current Git attributes/configuration.
hashContract.additionalBlobChecks: rawGitBlobSha1 and lfNormalizedGitBlobSha1 independently hash the Git blob header plus raw/normalized bytes. gitCleanMatchesLfNormalized records whether the actual Git clean filter produces the normalized blob.

canonicalCore.scope: Every non-test .ts file recursively in src/core/matchSimulation; aggregate paths are relative to this directory, matching the benchmark source fingerprint.

appRuntime.scope: Every non-test .ts, .tsx, .js, .mjs or .css runtime file recursively under src/app; aggregate paths are repository-relative.

benchmarkScripts.scope: Every non-test .ts, .js or .mjs file recursively under scripts, covering benchmark entry points, imported helpers and TypeScript loaders; aggregate paths are repository-relative.
